global_requirement_ids.description: Existing requirement IDs only from categories exclusion, constraint, non_functional or authorization. A functional requirement or business_rule must be assigned to work nodes even when cross-cutting; neither category may be globalized. An authorization global must also map to a local enforcement work node. Do not change requirement categories or use global placement to bypass blockers.
global_requirement_ids.title: Global Requirement Ids

required_resources.description: Resource identifiers needing separate availability/permission checks, including genuinely missing infrastructure or external services. Do not put provided local Python/SQLite/Git capabilities, supplied synthetic data, source rules, assumptions, or future task outputs here; functional prerequisites belong in depends_on and inputs. Use [] when no such resource prerequisite is missing. With no supplied resource inventory, every listed identifier is treated as unavailable; a declaration is never availability or authorization.
required_resources.title: Required Resources
